description: Political philosophy decomposed. Social contract (Hobbes, Locke, Rousseau), liberalism (classical + modern), libertarianism (Nozick), communitarianism, Marxism, anarchism, democratic theory, justice (distributive, retributive), rights, freedom (negative + positive).

sub_mechanisms.name: Hobbes_social_contract
sub_mechanisms.definition: Leviathan 1651. State of nature: war of all against all. Surrender freedoms to sovereign for peace.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation modern political philosophy. Absolute sovereignty justified by security. Influence: realism in IR.

sub_mechanisms.name: Locke_natural_rights
sub_mechanisms.definition: Two Treatises 1689. Life, liberty, property pre-political. Government legitimate by consent + protection of rights.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation liberalism + American founding. Property rights central. Influence: classical liberalism.

sub_mechanisms.name: Rousseau_general_will
sub_mechanisms.definition: Social Contract 1762. Legitimate authority via general will. Direct democracy ideal.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation participatory democracy. Critic of representative. Influence: revolution + populism.

sub_mechanisms.name: Mill_liberalism
sub_mechanisms.definition: On Liberty 1859. Harm principle: limit liberty only to prevent harm to others.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation modern liberalism. Tyranny of majority. Influence: free speech + privacy.

sub_mechanisms.name: Nozick_libertarianism
sub_mechanisms.definition: Anarchy State + Utopia 1974. Minimal state (night-watchman). Taxation = forced labor.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation libertarianism. Rights as side-constraints. Counter to Rawls. Influence: free market politics.

sub_mechanisms.name: communitarianism
sub_mechanisms.definition: Self situated in community + tradition. Sandel, MacIntyre, Walzer.
sub_mechanisms.why: Critique of liberal individualism. Influence: civic republicanism. Modern: contested neutrality.

sub_mechanisms.name: Marx_historical_materialism
sub_mechanisms.definition: History driven by material/economic conditions. Class struggle. Capitalism alienates labor.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation Marxism. Influence: social science, political movements. Critical theory descendant.

sub_mechanisms.name: anarchism_theory
sub_mechanisms.definition: No legitimate authority. Bakunin, Kropotkin (mutual aid). Modern: Chomsky.
sub_mechanisms.why: Radical anti-state. Different from libertarianism: also anti-capitalist (left anarchism). Foundation many movements.

sub_mechanisms.name: freedom_negative_positive
sub_mechanisms.definition: Berlin: negative = freedom from interference. Positive = freedom to self-realise.
sub_mechanisms.why: Two Concepts of Liberty 1958. Foundation political philosophy. Cold war context but enduring.

sub_mechanisms.name: deliberative_democracy
sub_mechanisms.definition: Habermas: legitimacy via public deliberation. Rational discourse central.
sub_mechanisms.why: Modern democratic theory. Foundation discourse ethics. Critique of mere voting. Influence: civic engagement.

sub_mechanisms.name: global_justice
sub_mechanisms.definition: Pogge, Singer: justice across borders. Cosmopolitanism + nationalism.
sub_mechanisms.why: Modern issue. Foundation effective altruism. Tension: special obligations to compatriots vs universal.

sub_mechanisms.name: intersectionality
sub_mechanisms.definition: Crenshaw: multiple identities intersect. Black women's experience not reducible to race + gender separately.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation modern feminism + critical theory. Influence: identity politics. Modern movements use.

derivation_rules.name: social_contract_justifies_state
then: justifies via consent to surrender some freedoms
derivation_rules.why: Hobbes, Locke, Rousseau, Rawls all use. Cost: actual consent never given. Hypothetical contract more defensible.

derivation_rules.name: harm_principle_limits_state
derivation_rules.why: Foundation liberalism. Critics: 'self-regarding' often affects others. Modern: drug policy, prostitution debates.

derivation_rules.name: Nozick_taxation_problematic
derivation_rules.why: Rights as side-constraints. Forced labor analogy. Counter to Rawls. Modern: libertarian politics. Critics: many.

derivation_rules.name: Rawls_vs_Nozick_distributive_justice
derivation_rules.why: Foundation contemporary political philosophy. Two influential opposing frameworks. Modern: progressive vs libertarian politics.

derivation_rules.name: deliberation_legitimates_decisions
derivation_rules.why: Reasons exchanged; all affected participated. Beyond voting. Modern: epistemic democracy. Tension: scale of mass democracy.
